principal_result: Full L104 census independently reproduced: 8 rank-two, 19 rank-three, 3 rank-four geometries, none of higher rank, under the paper's stated axioms and Aut(J2)/type equivalence.
classification_scope: All firm, flag-transitive, residually connected, residually weakly primitive J2 coset geometries satisfying (2T)1 and (IP)2.
trust_boundary: Completeness of the imported J2 subgroup catalogue.
GAP exact finite-group algorithms, including maximal subgroups, normalizers, transporters, intersections, cosets, and automorphism actions.
The stated arbitrary-rank completeness and recognition proof is a human-readable mathematical argument; no complete Lean formalization is claimed.
not_rederived: Every secondary annotation in the original supplement, such as full correlation groups or doubling relations.
